title: Master Physical Site Entity Schema
description: Authoritative physical facility, cemetery, church, residence, or landmark entity schema, linked to a parent civil location.

site_type.description: Classification of the physical or institutional site entity.

name.description: Authoritative primary designation of the physical site or landmark.

aliases.description: Alternative names, historical designations, or colloquial variations.

location_id.description: Foreign key link to the parent civil jurisdiction in locations.json.

address.description: Physical postal delivery line and geocoordinates.

operational_status.description: Real-world historical or operational condition of the physical facility.

is_deprecated.description: True if soft-deleted, merged, or invalidated due to integrity issues.

superseded_by.description: Pointer to the replacing canonical SID-##### if superseded or merged.

dissolution_date.description: Date when the facility, congregation, or cemetery closed or ceased operation.
